source: Installed FAC component docstrings and metadata.json in conda environment dash-demos; defaults and enumerations follow the generated parameter definitions.

mode.zh-cn: 选择器模式，用于配置单色与渐变，可选项有`'single'`、`'gradient'`，支持单选项或多选项组合。默认值：`'single'`。
mode.reason: Normalize the string default to match the parameter definition.

placement.zh-cn: 颜色选择面板展开方向，可选项有`'top'`、`'topLeft'`、`'topRight'`、`'bottom'`、`'bottomLeft'`、`'bottomRight'`。默认值：`'bottomLeft'`。
placement.reason: The original prose says bottomRight, but metadata and the parameter definition default to bottomLeft.

disabled.zh-cn: 分别设置开始日期和结束日期输入框是否禁用。默认值：`[False, False]`。
disabled.reason: The original prose describes a scalar False; the declared property is an array of booleans.

disabled.zh-cn: 分别设置开始时间和结束时间输入框是否禁用。默认值：`[False, False]`。
disabled.reason: The original prose describes a scalar False; the declared property is an array of booleans.

persisted_props.zh-cn: 开启属性持久化功能的属性名列表，可选项有`'value'`。默认值：`['value']`。
persisted_props.reason: The original prose names md5Value, which is not in this property's enumeration; metadata declares value.

placement.zh-cn: 气泡卡片展开方向，可选项有`'top'`、`'left'`、`'right'`、`'bottom'`、`'topLeft'`、`'topRight'`、`'bottomLeft'`、`'bottomRight'`、`'leftTop'`、`'leftBottom'`、`'rightTop'`、`'rightBottom'`。默认值：`'top'`。
placement.reason: Repair the missing quote in the original default.

transitionType.zh-cn: 卡片显隐动画类型，可选项有`'none'`、`'fade'`、`'zoom'`、`'zoom-big'`、`'zoom-big-fast'`、`'slide-up'`、`'slide-down'`、`'slide-left'`、`'slide-right'`、`'move-up'`、`'move-down'`、`'move-left'`、`'move-right'`。默认值：`'fade'`。
transitionType.reason: The original prose says zoom, but metadata and the parameter definition default to fade.

avatar.zh-cn: 配置头像占位图相关参数，设置为`False`时不显示。默认值：`False`。
avatar.reason: The original prose says True, but metadata and the parameter definition default to False.

autoFocus.zh-cn: 是否在组件挂载后自动获取焦点。默认值：`False`。
autoFocus.reason: The original prose incorrectly describes one-click clearing and says True; autoFocus controls focus and metadata defaults to False.

min.reason: The original prose says required, but metadata marks the property optional and supplies a default.

max.reason: The original prose says required, but metadata marks the property optional and supplies a default.

operations.zh-cn: 左右移动操作按钮内容。默认值：`['', '']`。
operations.reason: The original prose wraps the list default in extra string quotes.

defaultExpandParent.zh-cn: 初始化时是否展开处于展开状态节点的父节点。默认值：`False`。
defaultExpandParent.reason: The original prose says True, but metadata and the parameter definition default to False.

colon.zh-cn: 当`layout='horizontal'`时，控制是否在表单项标签部分末尾添加冒号。默认值：`True`。
colon.reason: The original prose misspells the existing layout property as layput.

locale.zh-cn: 强制设置后代元素的内置文案语种，可选项有`'zh-cn'`（简体中文）、`'en-us'`（英语）、`'de-de'`（德语）、`'ru-ru'`（俄语）、`'fr-fr'`（法语）。此设置优先于后代组件自身的`locale`，不会自动翻译自定义内容。
locale.reason: The original prose omits Russian although the enumeration includes ru-ru; clarify provider precedence and the custom-content boundary.
